name: Binance spot BTCUSDT partial book levels (top 20, 100 ms)
description: Flattened absolute price levels from the Binance spot `btcusdt@depth20@100ms` partial-depth stream. This definition promotes the existing refusal-gated capture adapter to an adopted source and describes exactly what that adapter already emits; it adds no adapter behaviour. Each message is a COMPLETE top-20 bid and ask replacement, not a diff: rows sharing `update_group` form one atomic source message, must be applied in `update_index` order, and a level absent from the message is gone from the top of book, so `update_kind` is always `snapshot`. The spot partial-depth message carries no venue clock and no first/final update ids, so `event_time_basis` is `receipt` and `last_update_id` is the only ordering guarantee: it must strictly increase, an equal value being a duplicate and a lower value out of order, both dropped and never applied. A message carrying no levels is a degenerate venue state: it is noted and skipped without normalized output, and the cursor is left untouched. The cursor resets on every new connection epoch. Refusal-gated: Binance redistribution requires written consent (see RIGHTS-LEDGER.md). image_kind discriminates a continuous image (full_replace: the previous applied image's last_update_id is the immediately preceding applied cursor value) from a reseed (the first image after a Connected record or any ordering reset); it is the continuity discriminator the Binance order-flow and book-resilience identities read, and it is new adapter work that re-derives the Binance fixture corpus. Rights-gated: the Binance row in knowledge/RIGHTS-LEDGER.md defers commercial redistribution, and the lane refuses to start unless SIGNALS_ENABLED_VENUES lists binance (R7).
